plan_name: Hospital Appointment Booking System MVP Plan

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with tables for users, doctors, appointments, and notifications
Implement JWT authentication and user registration/login endpoints using Node.js and Express
Build REST API endpoints for patient profile management (create, read, update)
Develop doctor search and filtering API with specialty and availability queries
Create appointment booking, cancellation, and rescheduling API endpoints with validation
Design and implement responsive UI components (buttons, cards, inputs) using React with the defined color scheme and typography
Build Home Dashboard screen with upcoming appointments display and quick action buttons
Implement Doctor Search screen with real-time filtering and specialty chips
Create Doctor Profile screen with availability calendar and time slot selection
Build Appointment Confirmation screen with booking details and notification preferences
Develop My Appointments screen with tab filtering (Upcoming, Past, Cancelled) and action buttons
Implement User Profile screen with editable personal and medical information sections
Integrate email and SMS notification system for appointment confirmations and reminders
Implement doctor profile management endpoints for availability and specialty updates
Add accessibility features including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support
Conduct end-to-end testing of booking flow and API integration

risks: Time slot conflicts if concurrent bookings are not properly handled with database locking mechanisms
Email/SMS notification delivery delays or failures could impact user experience and appointment adherence
Scalability issues with real-time doctor availability queries as user base grows
Data privacy and HIPAA compliance requirements may require additional security measures beyond JWT
Mobile responsiveness across diverse device sizes may require additional testing and adjustments
